proposed_widenings.name: alter_terrain
proposed_widenings.justification: Move Earth's core effect is reshaping physical terrain — raising/lowering elevation, forming trenches, walls, pillars in existing dirt/sand/clay. No v4 atom covers this. create_object is semantically wrong (no new object is conjured; existing terrain is geometrically deformed). alter_terrain would name the effect of mutating world-geometry in place.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation (kind: terrain_reshape)
proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family would structurally fit Move Earth (concentration, area attachment, timed duration) if OngoingOperation had a terrain_reshape variant. Currently only roll_modifier and damage_on_hit exist; neither covers area terrain manipulation. A terrain_reshape operation referencing the new alter_terrain atom would close the gap.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: periodic re-targeting within concentration (window or mechanism variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Move Earth lets the caster choose a new 40-foot area every 10 minutes of concentration. This is a periodic re-targeting mechanic with no analogue in the current atom set. No existing window atom (post_action_window, turn_start_window, rest_window, etc.) maps to 'end of every 10 minutes of concentration'. A periodic_concentration_window or a duration_interval sub-mechanism would be needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of every 10 minutes you spend Concentrating on the spell, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect within range.

notes: Move Earth fits ongoing_effect structurally (concentration, area attachment) but OngoingOperation has no variant for terrain manipulation, and the v4 atom inventory has no alter_terrain atom — create_object is the closest but is semantically wrong. Two widenings are required before encoding is honest: (1) new alter_terrain v4 atom; (2) new OngoingOperation.terrain_reshape surface variant. A third widening is needed for the 10-minute periodic re-targeting cadence within concentration, which has no analogue in current window atoms. No dhall/json authored.
